intro.text: One of Dusk's Aviar, whose absence troubles Dusk and Sak.
An Aviar who travels with the trapper Sixth of the Dusk on Patji, his talent hiding the minds around him from the island's predators.

items.text: Dusk bred Aviar and most likely raised Kokerlii himself. The bird had a nesting box at Dusk's safecamp, and as other trappers prized his talent, Dusk took him everywhere.
Five years before, Kokerlii rode at the front of Dusk's boat on the way to Patji, and his talent hid them from a great shape that swam close beneath the waves.

On a perilous night walk through the jungle with Dusk and Vathi, Dusk thought he would have to give himself up to a nightmaw and tried to hand Kokerlii to Vathi, but they found another way and the bird stayed with him.
In the years that followed, a plague swept through the Aviar and killed many of them, Kokerlii among them, until medicine from the Ones Above ended it within weeks.
When Vathi offered Dusk an Aviar of Kokerlii's breed for his journey, he turned her down at first, not ready to replace his old companion.
Dusk and Rokke came to grieve together, he for Kokerlii and she for the trapper she had lost.

appearance.text: Bright red and green feathers; about three fists tall, the usual size for an Aviar.

personality.text: Cheerful and chirpy, a bird Dusk calls oblivious. Like Aviar raised by people, he stays close to his master and would not fit in among wild Aviar.

items.text: He gained his talent visiting Patji's Eye as a chick: he hides all thought around him from predators that hunt by sensing minds, though the effect fades as he moves away.
Dusk never clipped his wings and trained him to come back at a whistle.
